description: This file defines a serializer and surrogate for the CultureInfo class, including conversion methods, a surrogate structure, and a copier class. It is part of the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: CultureInfoCodec
classes.description: Serializer for CultureInfo, converting to/from a surrogate.

classes.name: CultureInfoSurrogate
classes.description: Surrogate type holding minimal data for CultureInfo serialization.

classes.name: CultureInfoCopier
classes.description: A shallow copier for CultureInfo instances.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Populates the surrogate with CultureInfo data.
